task_description: UI-only. Fix broken in-app font scaling on the release Android APK and fix text clipping across most mobile screens. Replace the failed module-override font-scale mechanism with an app-owned AppText/AppTextInput that reads the FontScale context and applies a scaled fontSize via plain React composition, migrate all 34 files that import Text/TextInput from 'react-native', and apply layout-only clipping fixes (flexShrink/minWidth:0/flex/numberOfLines/adjustsFontSizeToFit/textAlign/includeFontPadding) so no Spanish text is clipped at font factors 1.0/1.15/1.3. No domain invariants affected.
